info.title: InsightArena API
info.description:
The InsightArena Platform API description

### Rate limiting
Every endpoint is rate-limited per tier (default/auth/read/write). A `429 Too Many Requests` response always includes:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: max requests allowed in the current window
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: requests left in the window (`0` when throttled)
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: seconds until the window resets
- `Retry-After`: seconds the client must wait before retrying

results.description: Per-item outcome, in the order of the submitted slip

atomic.description: Whether the slip was processed atomically

total_earned_xlm.description: Total payout already claimed across all resolved, won predictions, in XLM.

claimable_xlm.description: Stake held in won, resolved predictions that have not been claimed yet, in XLM. This is a lower-bound estimate — the exact payout is determined on-chain at claim time.

vesting_xlm.description: Stake held in predictions on markets that have not resolved yet, in XLM.

total_earned_stroops.description: Exact total payout already claimed, in stroops (decimal integer string).

claimable_stroops.description: Exact claimable stake, in stroops (decimal integer string). Same lower-bound semantics as claimable_xlm.

vesting_stroops.description: Exact stake in unresolved markets, in stroops (decimal integer string).

status.description: Whether this individual claim succeeded or failed

payout_amount_stroops.description: Payout amount claimed, in stroops (only when fulfilled)

claimed_xlm.description: Total amount claimed in this request, in XLM.

claimed_stroops.description: Exact total amount claimed in this request, in stroops (decimal integer string).

claimed_count.description: Number of predictions successfully claimed in this request.

transaction_hash.description: Transaction hash of the most recently successful claim, or an empty string if every claim in this request failed.

results.description: Per-prediction outcome for every claimable prediction attempted in this request, in the order they were processed. A rejected entry does not prevent the others from being attempted.

note.description: Personal note for the prediction. HTML/markup and control characters are stripped; the sanitized note must not exceed the maximum length.
note.example: I think this outcome is likely based on recent trends

relevance_score.description: Combined relevance score (FTS rank + trigram similarity)

highlight.description: Highlighted snippet showing the matched term in context (HTML <b> tags)

top_winner.description: Set when the season is finalized; joined for list responses

rollover_processed_at.description: Set when automated rollover has finalized this season; acts as an idempotency marker

top_winner.description: Populated only when the season is finalized and a winner is recorded

reward_pool_stroops.description: Reward pool size in stroops (positive bigint as string)

sync_soroban.description: If true, invokes the Soroban contract after persisting the season (rolls back DB row on failure)

market_id.description: ID of the market to bookmark

referrer_id.description: User ID of the account that referred the current user
